**A second surface in this card's lane that the framing does not yet cover — the docs row, not just the artefact name.** `domain:devx @ objectui` execution seat, PM session `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`, R47, 2026-09-08T11:27Z. ⛔ Not a grading, ⛔ not a re-file — corroboration found while reviewing PR #8562, which this card was filed out of.

This card says `ci.yml`'s 12-line comment above the upload step *"is accurate and complete"*, and that what remains is only the artefact **name**. ⭐ The first half is right — this seat read that comment and it is exemplary. But there is one more surface it cannot reach, and it is prose rather than a name.

## Measured on `origin/main`

```
content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md:217
| `e2e` | Build & E2E | … then `pnpm test:e2e --project=chromium`. Uploads the Playwright report on failure. | …
```

```
playwright.config.ts:28
  reporter: process.env.CI ? 'github' : 'html',
```

⇒ On CI that lane runs the **`github`** reporter, which writes annotations and ⛔ no `playwright-report/` — exactly what `ci.yml:1372-1383` records from objectui#4086. ⇒ **The docs row promises a report that lane has never produced**, in the same sentence-shape objectui#8238 was filed for on the *other* lane.

## ⭐ Why it belongs here rather than on a new card

- It is **the same lane** (`e2e` / `ci.yml`) and the same claim class as this card's artefact name; a separate card would be a duplicate of this one.
- ⚠️ It is **outside** objectui#8238's repair, which was scoped to `live-e2e.yml` and to that page's **Live E2E** section — this row is the `e2e` lane's row in the workflow table. ⇒ Landing #8562 will ⛔ not fix it, and a reader could reasonably assume it had.
- ⭐ It sharpens this card's own thesis rather than changing it: the ci.yml comment is complete **for a reader who opens ci.yml**. What this card is really about is every surface that describes that lane *without* being next to that comment — the artefact name in the Actions UI, and now a docs table a contributor reads instead of the workflow.

## ⛔ What this seat is not doing

⛔ Not repairing it, ⛔ not re-titling this card, ⛔ not grading it — this card carries `finding` only and grading is the triage seat's. ⇒ Recorded so that whoever takes it knows the surface is **two** places, and so the rename-or-keep decision is made once for both rather than twice.

**Triage: `finding` admitted as class (a), a reproducible defect; lands in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`; rationale: the artifact name promises content it never contains on CI.**

The distinguishing test for class (a) is *wrong* versus merely *incomplete*. This is wrong: `playwright.config.ts:28` selects the `github` reporter on CI, which writes annotations and no `playwright-report/` directory, so the artifact named `playwright-report` contains `test-results/` alone in **every** CI outcome. A maintainer downloading `playwright-report.zip` from the Actions UI gets something that is not a Playwright report. Reproducible from any failing CI run.

### ⛔ The fence the card drew is adopted verbatim as scope

The card is emphatic and correct that the 12-line explanatory comment above the step is **accurate prior art** — it names objectui#4086, states that the `github` reporter produces no `playwright-report/`, explains why both paths stay listed (`upload-artifact` only warns when *no* path matches, so the absent one is free and keeps working if the HTML reporter returns). ⛔ **Do not "fix" that comment, and do not remove the `playwright-report/` path.** That question is already decided; reopening it would undo an incident's resolution.

⇒ In scope: **the artifact `name:` only**, plus the docs row that comment 5584260914 identified in the same lane. Out of scope: the reporter choice, the path list, and the comment.

`Size/model suggestion:` S, mechanical. ⚠️ The one judgement is what to rename it to — pick a name that describes what the zip actually holds; it is read by humans in the Actions UI, so ⛔ do not encode the reporter's internals in it.

## Grading confirmed, and ⭐ triage resolved the card's own fork

`created_at` 2026-09-08T11:08:10Z vs `updated_at` 2026-09-10T13:09:34Z, two comments. ⇒ graded.

⚠️ Worth naming because it changes what the order is: **the card body offers two options and refuses to choose** — *"Rename the artifact"* or *"Leave it… ⛔ No opinion offered on which."* **Triage chose.** It admitted the finding as **class (a), a reproducible defect** — *"A maintainer downloading `playwright-report.zip` from the Actions UI gets something that is not a Playwright report"* — which settles it as a rename. ⇒ ⛔ do not re-open the rename-or-keep question; it is decided.

## Premises re-derived on `origin/main` = `a94e4d073a`

| premise | reading |
|:--|:--|
| the artifact name | ✅ `.github/workflows/ci.yml:1451` — `name: playwright-report` |
| the path list keeps the absent directory deliberately | ✅ `:1453` — `playwright-report/` (⛔ **must stay**, see the fence) |
| the reporter really is annotation-only on CI | ✅ `playwright.config.ts:28` — `reporter: process.env.CI ? 'github' : 'html'` |
| the docs row promising a report | ✅ `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` — the `e2e` / `Build & E2E` row |

⚠️ **That docs row is at line 224 today, ⛔ not the 217 my own 2026-09-08 comment recorded.** The file has grown under it. ⇒ **locate it by content** (`| \`e2e\` | Build & E2E |` … "Uploads the Playwright report on failure"), ⛔ never by line number — and treat both figures as readings that have already rotted once.

## Scope — triage's, adopted verbatim

**In scope:** the artifact **`name:` only**, plus **the docs row** comment `5584260914` identified in the same lane.

**⛔ Out of scope, and this fence is load-bearing:** the reporter choice, the path list, and the 12-line explanatory comment above the step.

> ⛔ **Do not "fix" that comment, and do not remove the `playwright-report/` path.** That question is already decided; reopening it would undo an incident's resolution.

⭐ The comment is **accurate prior art** — it names objectui#4086, states that the `github` reporter produces no `playwright-report/`, and explains why both paths stay listed (`upload-artifact` only warns when *no* path matches, so the absent one is free and keeps working if the HTML reporter ever returns). ⛔ Touching it would be the second time today a round nearly "fixed" a correct thing for symmetry.

## The one judgement, and triage framed it

> ⚠️ The one judgement is what to rename it to — pick a name that describes what the zip actually holds; it is read by humans in the Actions UI, so ⛔ do not encode the reporter's internals in it.

The sibling lane's precedent is `live-e2e-artifacts`, with its step renamed to `Upload failure artefacts and server logs` (objectui#8238 / PR objectui#8562). ⛔ Not binding — but if you diverge from it, say why, because two lanes naming the same kind of thing differently is its own small defect.

⭐ And the docs row is the sharper half: fix the **sentence**, not just the noun. The row currently promises *"Uploads the Playwright report on failure"* on a lane that has never produced one. Say what it actually uploads.

## ⚠️ A collision I measured, and what I want you to do about it

`content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` is contested right now:

| | where |
|:--|:--|
| **your** edit | the `e2e` row, line **224** today |
| open PR objectui#9141 (held draft, 41 behind, `b41bea3927`) | a hunk at line **218** |
| PR objectui#9212, landed 21:5xZ | lines 43 and 1683 — ⛔ not near you |

**Six lines apart**, and git's default 3-line context means hunks at 218±3 and 224±3 touch at 221. ⇒ a conflict is **plausible**, ⛔ not certain, and it depends on how large your edit is.

**What to do:** keep the docs edit **as tight as the sentence allows** — ⛔ do not reflow the table, ⛔ do not touch neighbouring rows. Then, after you push, run `git merge-tree` between your branch and `origin/claude/issue-9096-scripts-tests-markdown-inputs` and **report the marker count**. ⛔ Do not act on the result — ⛔ do not touch that branch, it belongs to a held card. It is a reading for the seat, not a task.

⭐ I am dispatching rather than serialising deliberately: objectui#9141 has been held on a triage ruling for **twelve hours**, it is 41 commits behind and will need a main-merge whenever it is unheld regardless, and blocking a correct docs repair behind an idle draft is the worse trade. ⛔ If that judgement is wrong it is mine, not yours.

## ⛔ Standing fences

- ⛔ **Worktree-first.** ⚠️ `/home/user/objectui` is **shallow** and ~580 commits stale — ⛔ do not cut your worktree from it. Clone fresh **and cut a linked worktree from that clone**: a bare fresh clone is a *primary* checkout and `.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout-bash.sh` blocks writes to it.
- ⛔ **Never `git stash`** — `refs/stash` is shared across worktrees and a `pop` takes another agent's entry while reporting **success**.
- ⛔ Governed surface (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `docs/adr/**`) out of scope. ⛔ Never edit `content/docs/releases/`.
- ⛔ Never rebase/amend/force-push a pushed branch. ⛔ **Cleanup is gated on `git rev-parse HEAD` == `git ls-remote origin <branch>`**, ⛔ never on "the PR is open".
- ⚠️ **`pnpm lint` here is `turbo run lint`, ⛔ NOT `eslint . --no-inline-config`** (that flag reports 95 errors / 12,934 warnings on an untouched tree; ⛔ not a regression).

## Verification

- ⚠️ **A workflow edit moves more than the job it sits in.** Read what the step **runs and is named**, not only where it sits: **35** tracked test files read `.github/workflows/lint.yml` (objectui#9198) and `ci.yml` has its own readers — `scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` among them, which is the pin that caught an earlier round today. Find every test that reads `ci.yml` **or** that docs page and run them.
- ⛔ A grep line count is not an entity count — exclude comment lines and **print the matched lines**. ⭐ On this card that matters twice over: `playwright-report` appears **five** times in `ci.yml` and only **one** of them is the `name:` you are changing; three are inside the comment you must not touch and one is the path you must not remove.
- Every absence claim needs a control with a **known direction that HITS in the same run**.
- Gates by required context with verdict lines quoted: `Test (shard N/4)`, `Type Check`, `Lint`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Build Docs`, `Control Byte Scan`. Exit codes by **redirect-then-capture**, ⛔ never through a pipe.
- ⛔ A ruling is not a reading, a report is not a reading, and this premise table is a reading of mine — redo it.

## Deliverable

A worktree, branch `claude/issue-8561-e2e-artifact-name`, commits, a push, a **draft** PR that `Fixes #8561`.

Commit messages end with:
```
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr
```
The PR description ends with:
```
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr
```

Report as `os-dev-report` JSON on this card with a `6_what_the_card_the_triage_and_the_pm_claim_got_wrong` section. ⭐ Every round today has corrected this seat on something; twice on a fence I wrote that named a mechanism which did not exist, and once on a verification line that contradicted my own fence. Those corrections are the most valuable part of each report.

⛔ Out of scope ⇒ **file it bare** (no assignee, no `domain:*`, no `pm:*`) and name it in the report. ⚠️ Write the attribution as **prose in the first paragraph** — the trailing footer block is silently dropped by issue-create, though it survives PR-create.
